reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount (null -> 0, range -> getExpectedAmount) instead of re-deriving the expected amount.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the API model only maps the field through the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API's schedule shape is built.

scope.why: One type field, one mapping line and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any change to the expected-amount rule flows to the API automatically through the shared helper.
